name: C01 terse is a Claude Code plugin whose
pattern: A Claude Code plugin that measures whether your documentation gives readers the right answer, and then repairs what it measured\.

name: C03 the plugin ships three skills.
pattern: Three skills\.

name: C05 `rethink` returns a skeleton that `rewrite`
pattern: /terse:rethink → skeleton → /terse:rewrite → candidate \+ diff → /terse:audit /terse:audit → run file → /terse:rewrite → candidate \+ diff → /terse:audit again what broke what to write did it hold

name: C06 audit builds a profile of the project's
pattern: \*\*`/terse:audit`\*\* builds a profile of who reads this project, derives the correct answers from the code, then sends one fresh reader per question through the documentation — `\.md` only, starting where a real reader starts\.

name: C07 audit returns a score, the questions that
pattern: It returns a score, the questions that failed, and why each failed: the text lied, the answer was nowhere, the true sentence sat where it misleads, it was there and unfindable, or every sentence was true and the sequence left the reader worse off\.

name: C09 rethink decides, before any prose is written
pattern: \*\*`/terse:rethink`\*\* decides what a document should be before a sentence of it is written: what comparable documents in the same genre already solved, what things should be called, and what is said in what order\.

name: C10 rethink hands over a skeleton, each section
pattern: It returns a skeleton — section titles, what each is for, what each leaves out, a word budget — and stops there for your word\.

name: C11 rewrite starts from a skeleton `rethink` agr
pattern: \*\*`/terse:rewrite`\*\* takes a skeleton or an audit's run file and writes against it\.

name: C12 three writers produce candidates and two jud
pattern: Three writers produce candidates and two judges score them on the failures rather than on taste; the winner then goes through a loop of critics whose lenses do not overlap — the code, the rules, an adversarial reader, a task, a reader's questions — until a round finds nothing new and nothing got worse\.

name: C13 every round of a rewrite stays on
pattern: Every round is kept as its own file\.

name: C15 rewrite writes its rounds and artefacts into
pattern: It writes into its own run directory\.

name: C16 nothing rewrite does changes the user's file
pattern: Applying anything to your files needs your word\.

name: C18 inside Claude Code, `/plugin marketplace add
pattern: /plugin marketplace add Nowely/agent-skills /plugin install terse@nowely

name: C19 from a shell, `claude plugin marketplace add
pattern: The same two steps from a shell: `claude plugin marketplace add Nowely/agent-skills`, then `claude plugin install terse@nowely`\.

name: C20 after the two install steps nothing else
pattern: Nothing else is needed — no dependencies, no configuration file, no account anywhere\.

name: C21 Node 22 or newer is needed only
pattern: Node 22 or newer if you run the checkout directly\.

name: C23 shortening the text is not terse's aim:
pattern: It is not a compressor\.

name: C24 on the one 2026-09-10 README the chain
pattern: On the one file measured, the chain moved 2,725 words to 2,571 — six percent — while the second pass cut 105 words and the third added 105 back as missing framing\.

name: C27 rewrite leaves every condition, limit and wa
pattern: It will not touch a condition, a limit or a warning at a point where you decide something\.

name: C30 everything under *What was measured* comes f
pattern: One run, on 2026-09-10, on one README in one repository\.

name: C33 three discordant pairs, all improvements, an
pattern: Three improvements and no reversals over six paired items gives an exact two-sided McNemar \*p\* = 0\.25, so this result is not distinguishable from chance\.

name: C39 the 2026-09-10 bake-off put five published w
pattern: Five published writing standards were put against two unguided controls across ten agents, models hidden from the judges\.

name: C41 on the audited README's first 116 words,
pattern: On the first 116 words, seven of ten agents proposed nothing and the only agent that shortened the passage was a control\.

name: C42 the passage result rests on ten agents
pattern: \*\*Ten agents, one run, one passage\*\* — one observation per cell, not a rate\.

name: C43 nothing in the record isolates which of
pattern: Not measured: which of the four passes produced the gain, and whether a bake-off beats one careful pass\.

name: C44 the 2026-09-10 measurement had no arm that
pattern: Also not measured, and worth knowing before you trust any of the above: there was no arm that ran the same questions with no document at all, so none of this separates what the text taught a reader from what the reader already knew\.

name: C45 two published benchmarks that ran a no-docum
pattern: Two published benchmarks that did run that arm found it large\.

name: C46 the plugin's reference files state the missi
pattern: The reference files say so where it matters, and \[references/prior-art\.md\]\(references/prior-art\.md\) collects every finding against these numbers\.
